caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware crock with two small handles on its sides, rendered in shades of light gray and beige. The rim and interior of the vessel are shown in a reddish-brown color, suggesting a glazed surface. On the front of the crock, there is a large stylized bird painted in blue, standing on a blue-dotted oval base, with decorative blue elements outlining its body and features. Above the bird and toward the top center of the crock, the number "2" is inscribed, indicating the vessel’s size or capacity. In the upper right corner of the composition is a small inset detail view, showing a close-up horizontal section of the crock’s upper rim and handle in similar colors, with a curved handle visible beneath the rim. The background is plain and off-white, and the whole arrangement appears on a rectangular piece of paper.
title: Crock
